name: agent-monitor
description: Live pane and band showing running subagents, background shells and scheduled tasks, with finish alerts. Zero model tokens by default.

showShell.title: Show background shells
showShell.description: Track Bash commands run with run_in_background.

showTasks.title: Show background tasks
showTasks.description: Track scheduled crons, monitors and workflows.

treeView.title: Tree view
treeView.description: Nest subagents under their parent. Off shows a flat list.

showBand.title: Summary band
showBand.description: Show a one-line summary above the prompt.

showButtons.title: Show buttons
showButtons.description: Show action buttons (view agent, clear finished, layout toggle).

autoOpenPane.title: Auto-open pane
autoOpenPane.description: Open the monitor pane when a subagent, shell or task starts. The /monitor command always works.

autoClosePane.title: Auto-close pane
autoClosePane.description: Close the pane the mod opened by itself once nothing is running or listed. A pane you open with /monitor stays open.

showCost.title: Cost and tokens
showCost.description: Show tokens and estimated cost per subagent, plus the spend of the last prompt and the session. Local data, no tokens used.

showSpinner.title: Spinner
showSpinner.description: Animate running rows with a spinner instead of a static dot.

flashOnFinish.title: Finish flash
flashOnFinish.description: Show a sparkle for a moment on items that just finished.

compactBand.title: Compact band
compactBand.description: A shorter band: counts and progress only, without the latest item names.

cleanLayout.title: Clean layout
cleanLayout.description: Hide the help line, duplicate header counts, section mini-bars and the status lines under the sections.

showTiles.title: Summary tiles
showTiles.description: Three tiles under the header: running, done and cost.

glowEffect.title: Glow
glowEffect.description: A soft glow on running bars, the Running tile and the narrow-pane dots.

pulseEffect.title: Pulse
pulseEffect.description: Running bars and the glow slowly pulse. Respects reduced motion.

clearAfterSeconds.title: Clear finished after (seconds)
clearAfterSeconds.description: -1 keeps finished items for the whole session, 0 removes them immediately.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often agent state is polled. Local only, no tokens.

notifyToast.title: Toast on finish
notifyToast.description: Show a toast when an item finishes or fails.

notifySound.title: Sound on finish
notifySound.description: Play a short chime when an item finishes or fails.

showResultPreview.title: Result preview
showResultPreview.description: Show the first line of a finished subagent's final answer under its row. No tokens used.

aiSummary.title: AI summary of finished agents (uses tokens)
aiSummary.description: WARNING: sends each finished subagent's last message to a small model for a one-line summary. This consumes tokens. Off by default.

stuckAfterSeconds.title: Flag as stuck after (seconds)
stuckAfterSeconds.description: Running items older than this turn orange. 0 turns it off.

theme.title: Color theme (0 Ocean, 1 Sunset, 2 Forest, 3 Mono, 4 Pastel)
theme.description: Palette used for the sections and chips.

showTimeline.title: Timeline
showTimeline.description: Show one lane per item on a shared time axis.

showLog.title: Event log
showLog.description: Show start and finish lines with the time.
